title: Refragged
wikitext:
Refragged is a QuakeWorld website which features daily news, articles, results and interviews with top players.

== Information ==
* Founder: [[Åke Vader]] (around 2001-2002, revived in 2009)
* Website: http://www.refragged.com

== History ==
Refragged was founded by [[Åke Vader]] back in 2001 or 2002 when he thought the current QuakeWorld sites were lacking in various areas. There have been three or four versions of the site and many helpful quakers volunteered for the crew along the road.

The site was quite a success when the last version of it was launched. It was a nice and probably a much needed competitor to [[QuakeWorld.nu]] which was (and still is) the main QuakeWorld site back then. The strengths of Refragged were their thorough interviews and good news flow.

Between 2006-2009 the site was down, but was revived in late 2009 again in time for [[QHLAN13]].
